mapper.select: SELECT pay11_month_item_id AS month_item_id, pay11_month_id AS month_id, pay11_item_type AS item_type, pay11_item_cd AS item_cd, pay11_item_amt AS item_amt, f_cdnm('PayItemType', pay11_item_type, 1, f_sysdate()) AS item_type_nm, f_cdnm('NonTaxType', pay20_non_tax_type, 1, f_sysdate()) AS non_tax_type_nm, pay20_item_nm AS item_nm FROM pay11_month_item INNER JOIN pay20_item ON pay20_item_cd = pay11_item_cd WHERE pay11_month_id = #{monthId} AND pay11_item_type = #{itemType} ORDER BY pay11_item_cd
SELECT pay11_item_cd FROM pay11_month_item WHERE pay11_month_item_id = #{monthItemId} AND pay11_month_id = #{monthId}
mapper.sql: SELECT pay11_month_item_id AS month_item_id, pay11_month_id AS month_id, pay10_person_id AS person_id, pay11_item_type AS item_type, pay11_item_cd AS item_cd, pay11_item_amt AS item_amt, f_cdnm('PayItemType', pay11_item_type, 1, f_sysdate()) AS item_type_name, f_cdnm('NonTaxType', pay20_non_tax_type, 1, f_sysdate()) AS non_tax_type_name, pay20_item_nm AS item_name, emp01_emp_no AS person_no, f_emp_kor_nm(pay10_person_id) AS person_name, f_cdnm('EmpPosCode', emp03_pos_cd, emp01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS pos_name FROM pay11_month_item INNER JOIN pay10_month ON pay10_month_id = pay11_month_id INNER JOIN pay20_item ON pay20_item_cd = pay11_item_cd INNER JOIN emp01_person ON pay10_person_id = emp01_person_id INNER JOIN emp02_others ON pay10_person_id = emp02_person_id INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON pay10_person_id = emp03_person_id WHERE (emp03_person_id, emp03_trans_date) IN ( SELECT emp03_person_id, MAX(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON emp03_person_id = emp01_person_id WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp03_trans_date <= #{payDate} GROUP BY emp03_person_id ) AND pay10_company_id = #{companyId} AND pay10_date = #{payDate} AND pay10_pay_cd = #{payCode} AND pay11_item_cd LIKE #{itemCode} AND UPPER(CONCAT(f_emp_kor_nm(pay10_person_id), pay20_item_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY emp01_emp_no, pay11_item_type, pay20_item_cd
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pay20_item WHERE pay20_item_type = #{itemType} AND pay20_item_cd = #{itemCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys99_print ( sys99_print_id, sys99_company_id, sys99_person_id, sys99_window_class_nm, sys99_group_id , sys99_string01, sys99_string02, sys99_string03, sys99_string04, sys99_string05, sys99_long01 ) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{printPersonId}, #{windowClassName}, #{groupId} , q.person_no, q.person_name, q.pos_name, q.item_type_name, q.item_name, COALESCE(q.item_amt, 0) FROM () q
